blindness_caveat: This record was created from independent press coverage and public company announcements before any Trump Entertainment Resorts SEC filing corpus or Helix output was fetched or inspected for this study. No SEC filing text was used. The list is deliberately scoped to three completed control or asset-transfer events with identifiable counterparties rather than treating every bankruptcy reorganization, casino closure, licensing change, or attempted sale as an M&A event.
note: Scoped to the completed 2016 debt-for-equity change of control because the frozen M&A-S1 audit window begins on 2015-01-01. The completed 2005 Majestic Star and 2011 Landry's asset sales are documented historical transactions but are deliberately excluded as out of scope. This remains a bankruptcy-heavy stress case: Trump Entertainment Resorts emerged from Chapter 11 as a wholly owned Icahn Enterprises subsidiary. The later Hard Rock purchase of the former Trump Taj Mahal is excluded because Icahn Enterprises announced that disposition after it had already acquired Trump Entertainment Resorts.

events.notes: Trump Entertainment Resorts emerged from Chapter 11 and became a wholly owned subsidiary of Icahn Enterprises through a debt-for-equity reorganization
